# `set_img_name_field`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Choose which fields (temperature, gain, camera name) go into saved image file names.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcce30, SetImgNameField @0x121420 (64-bit build) |

Copies the current name-field settings, overwrites the temp, gain and camera_name switches that are present in the request and writes the result to configuration. The bin and date_time fields and a temperature-unit switch exist internally but cannot be changed through this call (get_img_name_field reports bin as always true). Write failures are not tested, so there is no error reply for them.

Side effects: Writes changed name-field flags to persistent configuration and updates the shared settings struct. Synchronous, no timeout.

## Example

Request, object-form - Enable temperature and gain in names:

```json
{"id":131,"method":"set_img_name_field","params":{"temp":true,"gain":true,"camera_name":false}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_img_name_field","result":0,"code":0,"id":131}
```

Reply, no-params:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_img_name_field","error":"expected object param","code":107,"id":132}
```
